name: Immich
summary: Please don't open LLM-generated pull requests, and never use LLMs on good first issues. Descriptions and comments must be in your own words; translation is fine.

evidence.quote: We ask you not to open PRs generated with an LLM.
Using LLMs to fix issues labelled as “good first issue” is forbidden, and those PRs will be closed automatically.
Communication should be between humans. We want to hear from you in your own words.
Posting descriptions or comments that have been generated by an LLM is not acceptable, and may be grounds for us to close a thread without further comment.
If you use an LLM to translate a PR description or title, that is fine, although we recommend using purpose-built machine translation tools instead.
